data.body_html:
If you want to enjoy Marbella’s coastline without a boating licence, you’re in the right place. No license boat rental prices in Marbella 2039 start at €749 for 2 hours on an Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, and every charter includes a professional skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance and 21% IVA. You don’t need any paperwork — just show up at Puerto Banús and step aboard.

Below is the full breakdown of prices, what’s included, and which boat suits your group size and budget. All our boats depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella’s iconic marina, and range from 6.4m speedboats to 29m superyachts.

No Licence? No Problem – How It Works

Spanish law requires a recreational boating licence to drive a boat over 5m in length. But when you charter with us, a licensed skipper is included in the price. They handle everything: navigation, anchoring, safety briefings and docking.

You just relax, swim, sunbathe and enjoy the views of La Concha mountain, the Golden Mile and the Costa del Sol coastline. No exam, no test, no stress.

No License Boat Rental Prices Marbella 2039 – Tier A

These are our most popular no-licence options for small to medium groups. Prices are fixed and include everything.

BoatLengthMax Pax2 Hours8 Hours
Astondoa 4012.5m9€749€2,299
Azimut 3912.5m11€749€2,299

Both boats are modern, comfortable motor yachts with sun pads, a small cabin, and a bimini for shade. Ideal for a couple or a family group. Browse all available boats for more options.

No License Boat Rental Prices Marbella 2039 – Tier B (Mangusta 80)

For a larger, more luxurious experience, the Mangusta 80 (available in white or grey) is our premium no-licence option. It’s 24 metres long, takes 12 passengers, and comes with a free jet ski.

BoatLengthMax PaxMinimum CharterPrice

Mangusta 80 (Grey)24m124 hours€4,719

This price includes the jet ski, skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance and tax. Perfect for a birthday bash, corporate outing or a luxury day on the water.

Other Boats – Pricing on Request

We also offer a wider fleet with no-licence skippered charters. Prices for these boats are available via WhatsApp – simply contact us with your preferred dates and group size.

  • Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) – flagship superyacht
  • Canados 86 (26m, 12 pax) – classic Italian style
  • Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) – flybridge lounging
  • Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax) – sporty performance
  • Fairline Targa 12m (12m, 10 pax) – British craftsmanship
  • Lagoon 380 (11.6m, 10 pax) – catamaran stability
  • Bandido (11.5m, 8 pax) – open bow rider
  • Speedboat (7m, 6 pax) – adrenaline option
  • Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax) – compact fun
  • Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) – intimate charter
  • Red Tide (11m, 6 pax) – classic motorboat
  • K80 (24m, 12 pax) – modern luxury
  • Maiora 26m (26m, 12 pax) – elegant superyacht

All include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance and IVA. Contact us via WhatsApp for a custom quote.

What’s Included in Every No-Licence Charter

Every boat rental includes the following at no extra cost:

  • Licensed skipper
  • Fuel for the entire charter
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (chips, olives, nuts)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%)

There are no hidden fees. The price you see is the final price.

Where You’ll Cruise – Marbella’s Best Spots

Departing from Puerto Banús, your skipper will suggest a route based on the weather and your preferences. Popular destinations include:

  • Cala del Faro – a quiet cove west of Banús
  • Cala Cortés – crystal-clear water, great for swimming
  • Marbella Marina – see the Golden Mile from the sea
  • Cabopino – sandy beaches and dunes
  • Estepona – charming town with a scenic coastline
  • Sotogrande – luxury enclave and polo country

Most charters include time to swim, use the jet ski (on Mangusta 80), and enjoy the Mediterranean sun.

How to Book Your No-Licence Boat Rental

Booking is simple:

  1. Choose your boat from the list above.
  2. Check availability via our online calendar or WhatsApp.
  3. Pay a deposit to secure your date.
  4. Show up at Puerto Banús 15 minutes before departure – no licence needed.

We recommend booking at least 48 hours in advance, especially during peak season (June–September). Start your booking here.

Frequently Asked Questions

Do I need a boating licence to rent a boat in Marbella?

No. Every boat in our fleet comes with a licensed skipper who handles navigation, mooring and safety. You just relax and enjoy the coast. No licence, no experience needed.

What is the cheapest no-licence boat rental in Marbella for 2039?

The cheapest option is the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 at €749 for 2 hours. Both are 12.5m motor yachts that take up to 11 passengers. Price includes skipper, fuel, drinks and tax.

Are drinks and food included in the rental price?

Yes. Every charter includes water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava and light snacks. You can bring your own food and extra drinks if you wish, but the basics are covered.

How much does a full-day no-licence boat rental cost in Marbella?

For the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, a full 8-hour day costs €2,299. Larger boats like the Mangusta 80 start at €4,719 for 4 hours. All prices include everything – no extras.

What is included in the Mangusta 80 rental?

The Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 passengers) costs €4,719 for a minimum 4-hour charter. That includes a free jet ski, licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance and 21% IVA.

Can I rent a boat without a skipper in Marbella?

We only offer skippered charters. Spanish regulations and our insurance require a licensed professional on board. This means you don’t need a licence and you get a local expert as captain.

How do I book a no-licence boat in Marbella?

You can book directly through our website or contact us via WhatsApp for availability and custom requests. For boats not listed with fixed prices, we’ll provide a quote within minutes.

What happens if the weather is bad on my booking day?

Safety comes first. If the skipper deems conditions unsafe, we’ll reschedule your charter at no extra cost or offer a full refund. You won’t lose your money.
